## Current whole-M1 assessment

Retained private ancestor identities now prevent project-root replacement between checks, and31 focused tests pass independently. Prior destination no-clobber, public immediate-parent pinning, exact creation mode, rollback handling and late-descriptor storage remain intact. The public installer is still unconnected. Current author m1-root-authority-correction evidence records31 focused,431 full Node and7 publication passes. Design r5 and Delivery r2 remain unchanged.

The authority correction still pins only one endpoint of a cross-directory rename. saveOriginal uses withParent(projectRoot,path, name => renameSync(name, backupAbsolute), authority): source is a basename in the pinned original parent, but backupAbsolute resolves projectRoot and staging ancestors again inside the syscall. Rollback detachment uses the same absolute private-destination pattern. Checking the destination before pinning and checking root identity after mutation cannot prevent an overwrite occurring during that final interval.

## Remaining m1-review-f2: private destination redirection

A deterministic real-filesystem interleaving intercepts saving rigorloop.lock immediately before rename. It copies the current fixture tree to a separate unrelated directory, renames the original project away, symlinks projectRoot to the copy, and places independent bytes at the would-be backup destination in the copy. The original source basename stays pinned to the original root, while the absolute destination follows the new symlink. Rename overwrites the unrelated destination with original lock bytes. The next root check reports recovery-required only after independent data has been lost.

Executed node /tmp/reproduce-managed-private-destination-swap.mjs. Observed injected=true, error=managed-authoring-recovery-required, observed="old state", expected="independent unrelated bytes". The complete harness below uses only a disposable project and does not edit repository/customer files.

The required f2 outcome remains: anchor and protect both source and destination, including retained staging authority for save/rollback, so admitted namespace changes cannot redirect writes or overwrite unrelated bytes. A pathname being private/random does not establish stable authority when its project-root ancestor is mutable. Extra pre/post checks alone do not close this interval. If the portable mechanism cannot establish the required filesystem authority, Design must explicitly own that feasibility boundary rather than weakening the accepted protection silently.

```js
import fs from 'node:fs';
import {syncBuiltinESMExports} from 'node:module';
import {tmpdir} from 'node:os';
import {join} from 'node:path';
import {captureManagedBasis,replaceManagedAuthoring} from '/home/xiongxianfei/data/20260419-rigorloop/packages/rigorloop/dist/lib/managed-authoring-replacement.js';
const home=fs.mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(),'review-private-dest-'));const root=join(home,'project');const outside=join(home,'unrelated');const roots=['.agents/skills'];fs.mkdirSync(join(root,roots[0]),{recursive:true});fs.writeFileSync(join(root,roots[0],'spec.md'),'old skill');for(const name of ['rigorloop.yaml','rigorloop.lock'])fs.writeFileSync(join(root,name),'old state');
const basis=captureManagedBasis({projectRoot:root,roots});const rename=fs.renameSync;let injected=false;let redirected;
fs.renameSync=(from,to)=>{if(!injected&&from==='rigorloop.lock'&&to.includes('/old/2')){injected=true;fs.cpSync(root,outside,{recursive:true});rename(root,join(home,'original'));fs.symlinkSync(outside,root);fs.writeFileSync(to,'independent unrelated bytes');redirected=to.replace(root,outside);}return rename(from,to);};syncBuiltinESMExports();let error;
try{replaceManagedAuthoring({projectRoot:root,roots,basis,files:[{path:'.agents/skills/design.md',content:Buffer.from('new skill')}],state:{'rigorloop.yaml':Buffer.from('new manifest'),'rigorloop.lock':Buffer.from('new lock')}});}catch(e){error=e.code;}finally{fs.renameSync=rename;syncBuiltinESMExports();}
console.log(JSON.stringify({injected,error,observed:redirected&&fs.readFileSync(redirected,'utf8'),expected:'independent unrelated bytes'}));fs.rmSync(home,{recursive:true,force:true});
```

Independent bytes are overwritten before conflict reporting. Architecture and unrelated-diff scope remain confined to the private M1 helper/tests; public compatibility and derived artifact claims remain unchanged. Existing tests preserve meaningful protections but do not exercise a redirected private destination after final checks.

Independently ran node --test packages/rigorloop/test/managed-authoring-replacement.test.js:31 passed. Broad Node/publication passes are current author evidence, not rerun here. No M2/public installation, final review or Verify claim. Record-store validation and git diff --check follow saving. f1 stays resolved; f2 original origin/evidence/subjects stay intact and open.
